messages:
maria (product): Cutting RC v3.0.0-rc1 now. Target promo window tonight 02:00 UTC. DB migration included in this RC. Need: sherpa, oncall ack, QA + perf sanity, and a pinned artifact. Also confirm circuit-breaker thresholds and rollback playbook.

sanjay (eng-release): +1. artifact built from main @ 9:12pm. CI green. Migration script reviewed by dbeng. Can we pin artifact and run a quick KV warm?

lina (sherpa): I can sheriff the promo. I'll be online from 01:30 UTC. Can someone post the pin command and rollback steps here?

alex (eng-platform): Pin command below. I'll kick off a KV warm after pin and confirm memory footprints.

```
./deploy pin --artifact=redwood/inference:v3.0.0-rc1 --env=prod --reason="RC promo 02:00 UTC"
```

jamie (oncall): I'll take oncall for the window. What's the circuit-breaker? thresholds? error budget?

maria (product): Circuit-breaker proposal: if 5xx rate > 3% for 5 consecutive minutes or median p95 latency increases > 50% vs baseline for 3m -> pause rollout and escalate. If error budget breach persists for 10m -> rollback to previous stable. Lina will coordinate.

lina (sherpa): Ack to circuit-breaker. I'll flip the promo to pause and call rollback if triggers hit. Who owns the rollback exec?

sanjay (eng-release): Ops owns exec but eng-release will run the rollback command. Rollback snippet:

```
# rollback to last stable
./deploy promote --artifact=redwood/inference:v2.9.8 --env=prod --reason="rollback v3.0.0-rc1"
```

opsbot: NOTE: Migration included. If rollback happens, DB migration is NOT reversible automatically. We have a compensation script: `scripts/db/compensate_v3_to_v2.sh` — must be run manually after rollback and validated by DB eng.

jamie (oncall): Important callout from opsbot noted. We should ensure migration is backwards safe or be prepared for manual mitigation. DB eng confirmed minor additive column only — opsbot correct on manual step.

deploy-bot: Artifact redwood/inference:v3.0.0-rc1 pinned by @sanjay at 21:45 UTC. Pin ID: pin-202603-841234.

alex (eng-platform): KV warm started on canary nodes (5% traffic) after pin. Will post heatmap in 10m. Also enabling minibatch to 32 for this build's kernel path.

maria (product): Release notes: https://confluence.redwood.ai/releases/v3-0-0-rc1. Please check the breaking changes section (auth header normalization) — QA should sanity that.

lina (sherpa): QA ack: ran smoke + three prompt evals, LLM outputs look stable vs baseline. No obvious regressions. Perf: p95 +8% on canary, under threshold.

jamie (oncall): Promoting plan: staged rollout 5% -> 25% (10m) -> 60% (20m) -> 100% (30m) with telemetry gates at each step. I'll watch alerts and hold if anomalies.

sanjay (eng-release): I'll trigger the promo at 02:00 UTC. If we see the first gate fail, we'll pause and circle. Feature flags we can flip to mitigate: `ff/normalize-auth` (off -> on). Prep commands:

```
# stage promote
./deploy set-traffic --artifact=redwood/inference:v3.0.0-rc1 --env=prod --percent=5
# promote to next stage
./deploy set-traffic --percent=25
```

maria (product): All good from product side. Noting marketing has the notes for release channel.

lina (sherpa): I'll be the point if we need circuit-breaker action. Jamie + Alex, please DM if you need me to run the rollback or flip flags.

opsbot: REMINDER: Quiet window 01:50-03:10 UTC configured for product releases. No non-critical changes during this time.

deploy-bot: Scheduling staged rollout for redwood/inference:v3.0.0-rc1 at 02:00 UTC. Canary route = inference-canary-1.

alex (eng-platform): Noted. I'll enable additional tracing span for tokenization during the canary so we can get faster root-cause on latency spikes.

jamie (oncall): If rollback needed, priority order: 1) set-traffic 0% for v3 -> 2) promote v2.9.8 -> 3) run compensation script if needed -> 4) open incident if user impact. Keep timeline logs.

sanjay (eng-release): All sign-offs in thread: QA (lina), Product (maria), Oncall (jamie), Platform (alex). I'm going to hit the promo button at 02:00 UTC. Lina, you'll be sherpa and call the rollback if CB triggers.

lina (sherpa): Affirmative. I'll start the post-promo check at +5m and +15m.

maria (product): Thanks team. Good luck. :rocket:

deploy-bot: Promo executed: 5% traffic started for redwood/inference:v3.0.0-rc1 at 02:00:03 UTC. Track logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/q/8412345678

alex (eng-platform): KV warm successful, tokenization spans look normal. p95 on canary holding.

jamie (oncall): Monitoring. No alarms so far.

lina (sherpa): +1 on health checks. Proceed to 25% in 10m unless something changes.

deploy-bot: Traffic moved to 25% at 02:10:05 UTC.

maria (product): Confirming release notes channel has draft ready to publish once we hit 100%.

sanjay (eng-release): If all green I'll continue the ramp. Rolling forward.

deploy-bot: Traffic moved to 60% at 02:30:12 UTC.

jamie (oncall): Small spike at 02:31 — p95 increased by 20% for 3m, but no 5xx. Will keep monitoring.

lina (sherpa): Noting the spike. Alex are tokenization spans correlated?

alex (eng-platform): Looking — spans show slight GC pressure on a subset of instances, scaling group added two nodes automatically. p95 trending down. No rollback.

maria (product): Green from product, publishing release notes after 100% complete.

sanjay (eng-release): Moving to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic moved to 100% at 02:55:01 UTC. Promo complete. Final note: Keep the shard-level logs for 72 hours for regressions.

lina (sherpa): Closing sherpa. No rollback needed. Good job team. :tada:
